imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures at zoom 19 for covered tiles. Six rural sites had no zoom-19 imagery tiles and were recaptured at zoom 18. Visible station building, on-site parking and circulation/apron were fitted to a rotated rectangle using the recorded map scale.

roads.assessment: Packaged road/service-drive centerlines were inspected alongside imagery. Spawns are modeled points snapped to a selected mapped centerline, used to connect the fitted site apron to the local road network; they are not verified driveways, gates or apparatus entrances.

limits: Fit centers, rectangle dimensions, rotations and spawn coordinates are imagery- and road-map-based estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No official station parcel plans, building footprints or apparatus access routes were used.
Satellite imagery dates are not supplied by the tile response.
Canonical station IDs and source coordinates are preserved.
Six rural sites used Esri zoom-18 imagery because no zoom-19 tiles were available.

EMS 384 address is corroborated by the City of Ottawa facility energy-report listing; its modeled spawn was moved from an unrouteable mapped service loop to the Lord Byng Way centerline. This is a modeled network connection, not confirmed station access.

sources.limit: Confirms the facility listing at 50 Lord Byng Way; does not verify coordinates, entrance or road connection.
